answer: At each epoch's zenith, require live cross-examination: identities are paired into simultaneous duets where each must answer an unpredictable, context-grounded probe — in your own words, what this haven's treasury paid out yesterday, or finish this sonnet with your own line and explain it. One operator behind many faces cannot split deep, responsive cognition N ways in real time; its clones' latencies, quirks, and confabulated facts correlate across duets, betraying the single mind. Evasion means slow answers or genuine per-face cognition — either way the farm pays per fake.
